query: SELECT event_type,action,actor_login,created_at,updated_at,title,body,comment_id,comments,state,closed_at,file_time,repo_name,number FROM github_events WHERE repo_name='bbc/simorgh' AND number=3721 AND event_type IN ('IssuesEvent','IssueCommentEvent') ORDER BY created_at,file_time FORMAT JSON

data.title: Update translations for services
data.body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
We have updated translations for these services:

Afaan Oromoo
Afrique
Amharic
Arabic
Azeri
Gahuza
Hausa
Igbo
Indonesian
Japanese
Korean
Pashto
Persian
Pidgin
Punjabi
Somali
Swahili
Thai
Tigrinya
Urdu
Vietnamese
Yoruba

We should update Simorgh so that it has all of the translations.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
- Update the service configs at `src/app/lib/config/services/:service.js`
- Check the Simorgh pages load correctly: localhost urls are here: https://github.com/bbc/simorgh/wiki/Simorgh-Pages 

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
N/A

**Testing notes**
[Tester to complete]

Dev insight: Before putting the PR through code review, the full cypress test suite should be run (all page types for all services) with `CYPRESS_SMOKE=false npm run test:e2e`

- [ ] This feature is expected to need manual testing.

**Additional context**
N/A
